overview: The Medford Community Development Board met to conduct a public hearing on a special permit for 70 Lincoln Road and to deliberate on a proposed zoning amendment for the Boston Avenue neighborhood corridor.

items.title: 70 Lincoln Road Special Permit
items.summary: Approved a special permit to construct a second single-family structure at 70 Lincoln Road, with conditions requiring a landscape plan for tree preservation and replacement, as well as sidewalk reconstruction to city standards.

items.title: Boston Avenue Neighborhood Corridor Zoning Amendment
items.summary: Approved a recommendation to transmit the edited zoning ordinance to the City Council, noting a split within the board regarding the interpretation of a proposed 60-foot setback along North Street.

items.title: Postponement and Continuation of Public Hearing
items.summary: Approved continuing the public hearing to September 16, 2026, while postponing the developer incentive review to a future meeting.
